risk_note: RV2 (identity deletion processing; reads funds, writes none). D10-137 / D10-186 / BR-ID-27/28: processing requests run on B1-15f's 60-second timer before cooling expiry: cleanup transaction (sessions revoked with reason account_deleted, nickname/avatar reset, real name cleared or kept as status=none + tax_retained for users with a paid-out withdrawal, payout accounts anonymized per 0077, login_logs detached, owner-module ports called), Apple revocation outside the transaction (one try per round, alert and recorded failure on the third), completion transaction (phone and device identifiers into deleted_identities for 180 days, user_oauth removed, users tombstone, transition COMPLETE to done). A positive balance without an approved adjustment, or an owner port that is not shipped yet (linking, notification, catalog; agent not wired: AGENT_USER_HASH_KEY missing), keeps the request in processing with a daily alert (TODO markers in place). Funds are read only. Full verification on the AWS test machine; required CI checks on the PR head. Rebased over B2-05e: app.module's deletion withdrawal reader keeps payout's createWithdrawalInFlightReader (hasInFlight / hasNonTerminal) and only adds the hasSucceeded placeholder (false until payout offers a paid-out reader, TODO).

reviews.note: round 1 pass, no findings (couli-runs/B1-15g/review-money-r1.json); Codex unavailable until 10-30 (approvals #36)
